author: /root/benchmark_audit
scope: Exact adapter/default/entry rejection/real backend propagation and frontend-vs-object identity separation; not a second audit of the core internalization algorithm and not a performance result.

findings.detail: CompileOptions defaults closed_executable to false. The CLI switch only sets true explicitly. The driver copies it to BuildOptions after a fresh Verify and existing entry checks; the backend owns actual transformation/count. Independent LLVM API and Clang O0 builds verify once and produce 42. Default generated ZIL functions are global T symbols; closed mode changes them to local t symbols while main remains global T. This observes the real object/executable instead of trusting the report bool or prepartition sidecar.

Guard runs before compile_path/source I/O and requires action build, Stage::Build, Linux host, x86_64 Linux target and no Win64 configuration. Seven independent missing-source controls (check, run, Win64 target shorthand and full triple, Linux plus windows-lib, explicit linker, check stop-after=parse) return exit64/E-CLI-ARGUMENT; old executable is preserved and query directory is not created. HELP states the generated-symbol export contract restriction.

Exclusion of closed_executable from frontend key is explicit and limited to a post-Verify machine-linkage choice. It cannot alter discovery, parse, CT, Types, Analyze or Verify inputs. Real false→true→true→false requests use one unchanged entry/key with states miss/hit/hit/hit and Verify=1 every time. Installed compiler identity still distinguishes the CP13-producing binary from CP12.

Core internalization executes on actual partitioned Module items before PreparedCache lookup. machine_key hashes all actual items including Function.linkage, without normalizing them away. The same toggle sequence records object hits 0/0/1/1 and misses 1/1/0/0, leaving two distinct object entries. Restoring false reuses its old object instead of the closed one. The diagnostic LLVM sidecar remains prepartition text as documented; it is byte-equal across mode changes and is not used as the cache identity.

candidate_build_provenance: Author confirmed debug0/incremental0/default llvm-api built at exact ec089; subsequent bf090 changes evidence only. Before/after independent SHA256 matches e4dcc2cf638a27d5117b1c579d6c81353b831f5b16e7878eb4eeccf472911141. No candidate rebuild performed.
limitations: Linux x86_64 existing frozen binary only; non-Linux branch was read, not executed.
Bounded O0/1 CGU adapter probes. Core multi-CGU/capture/external-symbol semantics and O2 runtime/compile-time quality remain separate core and coordinator review obligations.
Raw LLVM sidecar is diagnostic prepartition IR; actual linkage was verified with nm.
The preceding CP12 review remains separately bound to 397 and is not silently upgraded to later source.

probe.source:
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/tmp/cp13-adapter-review-toolchain-setup/run-01')
ROOT.mkdir()
BIN = pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/ac5966c4c370/zil-cp12/target/debug/zil')
EXPECTED_SHA = 'e4dcc2cf638a27d5117b1c579d6c81353b831f5b16e7878eb4eeccf472911141'
assert hashlib.sha256(BIN.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_SHA
SOURCE = 'fn plus(x:i32)->i32=>x+1\nfn value()->i32{let f=plus;return f(41);}\n'
records = []

def execute(case, label, args):
    result = subprocess.run([str(BIN), *args], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    (case / f'{label}.stdout').write_bytes(result.stdout)
    (case / f'{label}.stderr').write_bytes(result.stderr)
    report = json.loads(result.stdout)
    (case / f'{label}.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    record = {'case': case.name, 'label': label, 'arguments': args, 'exit': result.returncode, 'report': report}
    records.append(record)
    return result, report, record

for backend in ['llvm-api', 'clang']:
    case = ROOT / backend
    case.mkdir()
    (case / 'main.zil').write_text(SOURCE)
    steps = [(False, 'miss', 0), (True, 'hit', 0), (True, 'hit', 1), (False, 'hit', 1)] if backend == 'llvm-api' else [(False, None, None), (True, None, None)]
    snapshots = []
    original_query = None
    original_key = None
    for index, (closed, state, object_hits) in enumerate(steps):
        label = f'{index}-' + ('closed' if closed else 'default')
        args = ['build', str(case / 'main.zil'), '-o', str(case / 'program'), '--entry', 'value', '--backend', backend, '--json']
        if closed:
            args.append('--closed-executable')
        if backend == 'llvm-api':
            args += ['--query-cache', str(case / 'queries'), '--object-cache', str(case / 'objects')]
        result, report, record = execute(case, label, args)
        assert result.returncode == 0, report
        assert report['status'] == 'Success'
        assert report['verification_runs'] == 1
        assert report['native_codegen']['closed_executable'] is closed
        count = report['native_codegen']['internalized_functions']
        assert count > 0 if closed else count == 0
        run = subprocess.run([str(case / 'program')], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        assert (run.returncode, run.stdout, run.stderr) == (0, b'42\n', b'')
        nm = subprocess.run(['nm', '--defined-only', '-P', str(case / 'program')], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=10).stdout.decode()
        (case / f'{label}.nm').write_text(nm)
        symbols = {line.split()[0]: line.split()[1] for line in nm.splitlines() if line.startswith('zil.fn.')}
        assert symbols, nm
        assert ('t' in symbols.values()) if closed else all(s == 'T' for s in symbols.values())
        assert any(line.startswith('main T ') for line in nm.splitlines()), nm
        llvm = (case / 'program.ll').read_bytes()
        snapshots.append(llvm)
        record.update({'native': {'exit': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout.decode()},
                       'symbols': symbols, 'nm': nm,
                       'llvm_sha256': hashlib.sha256(llvm).hexdigest(),
                       'executable_sha256': hashlib.sha256((case / 'program').read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
        if backend == 'llvm-api':
            q = report['query_cache']
            assert q['state'] == state, q
            obj = report['native_codegen']['object_cache']
            assert obj['hits'] == object_hits, obj
            assert obj['misses'] == (0 if object_hits else 1), obj
            if index == 0:
                original_key = q['key']
                original_query = next((case / 'queries/frontend-cp12-v1').glob('*.qcp')).read_bytes()
            assert q['key'] == original_key
            entries = list((case / 'queries/frontend-cp12-v1').glob('*.qcp'))
            assert len(entries) == 1
            assert entries[0].read_bytes() == original_query
    # The sidecar is intentionally the prepartition reference, not proof of applied linkage.
    assert all(x == snapshots[0] for x in snapshots)
    if backend == 'llvm-api':
        objects = sorted((case / 'objects').rglob('*.zobj'))
        assert len(objects) == 2
        (case / 'object-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'path':str(p), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in objects], indent=2)+'\n')

case = ROOT / 'reject-before-read'
case.mkdir()
for index, extra in enumerate([
    ['check'],
    ['run'],
    ['build', '--target', 'win64'],
    ['build', '--target', 'x86_64-pc-windows-msvc'],
    ['build', '--target', 'native', '--windows-lib', str(case / 'missing-import.lib')],
    ['build', '--linker', str(case / 'missing-lld-link')],
    ['check', '--stop-after', 'parse'],
]):
    action, *flags = extra
    label = str(index)
    (case / 'program').write_bytes(b'old executable sentinel')
    args = [action, str(case / 'missing-source.zil'), *flags, '-o', str(case / 'program'), '--query-cache', str(case / 'queries'), '--closed-executable', '--json']
    result, report, _ = execute(case, label, args)
    assert result.returncode == 64
    assert report['diagnostics'][0]['code'] == 'E-CLI-ARGUMENT', report
    assert 'complete Linux x86_64 build' in report['diagnostics'][0]['message']
    assert (case / 'program').read_bytes() == b'old executable sentinel'
    assert not (case / 'queries').exists()

help_result = subprocess.run([str(BIN), '--help'], capture_output=True, timeout=10, check=True)
assert b'--closed-executable' in help_result.stdout
assert b'generated ZIL symbols have no export contract' in help_result.stdout
(ROOT / 'help.txt').write_bytes(help_result.stdout)
assert hashlib.sha256(BIN.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_SHA
result = {'verdict':'Pass', 'implementation_commit':'ec089eab8088d1e616515fb573b66576323765e9',
          'binary':str(BIN), 'binary_sha256':EXPECTED_SHA, 'cli_compile_requests':len(records),
          'native_builds':6, 'pre-read_config_rejections':7, 'new_rust_builds':0,
          'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'records':records}
(ROOT / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k != 'records'}))

help:
ZIL 0.1.0 — compiler draft

Usage:
  zil check FILE [--stop-after parse|core|types|analyze|verify] [--json]
  zil build FILE [-o OUTPUT] [--entry NAME] [--emit-dir DIR] [--json]
  zil run FILE [--entry NAME] [--emit-dir DIR] [--json]
  zil qc [--tool PATH] COMMAND [OPTIONS]
  zil version

Options:
  --timings                 Record phase wall times (requires timings build feature)
  --cache-dir DIR           Store unverified source candidates
  --object-cache DIR        Trusted local LLVM API object cache (opt-in)
  --query-cache DIR         Trusted private local full-input frontend checkpoint (opt-in)
  --backend clang|llvm-api  Object generation strategy (standard build: llvm-api)
  --clang PATH              LLVM clang executable (default: ZIL_CLANG or clang)
  --emit-dir DIR            Write actual phase artifacts
  --target native|win64     Select the checked target ABI
  --windows-lib PATH        Explicit Win64 import archive (repeatable)
  --linker PATH             Win64 lld-link executable
  --opt O0|O2               Native LLVM optimization level
  --closed-executable       Opt-in Linux build; generated ZIL symbols have no export contract
  --codegen-units N         Maximum native units, 1..64 (default: 1)
  --codegen-jobs N          Concurrent native compiles, 1..64 (default: 1)
  --compile-timeout-ms N    Cooperative deadline checked between compiler phases
  --profile native|managed  Managed is explicitly Unsupported

Native run requires an explicit main; it adds no implicit module execution or GC.
Unsupported language features return Unsupported; they are never silently accepted.
